description: Get one converted file free and without watermark: a ZIP with its PDF, ODG, DOCX and page images. Limited to one free file per email address and one per batch. It needs the user's own email address: ask the user for it and use it only with their agreement, never an address they did not give for this. Aretus keeps only a one-way hash of the address to enforce the limit and sends no email. Temporary or disposable inboxes are refused. Right after conversion the DOCX and page images may still be in the making: then it answers preparing with retry_after.
